notes: All five old kinds kept (S-VHS, VHS-C, W-VHS as kinds with t); Video 2000, 8 mm video (Video8/Hi8/Digital8 as t) and MiniDV added. VHS collector forms (big box, pre-cert/video nasty, Disney Black Diamond) became archetypes; no film titles. No distributor-level archetypes for pre-cert labels: no fetched page named them.
